semantics.source_note: Stored source does not establish this field's dimension provenance. FEI/Thermo Fisher manuals place a differential-pumping aperture between the column and projection chamber and document a 200 micrometre aperture for Tecnai/Talos-family instruments. The Titan-specific plate thickness and bore are not established by a production drawing; the zero-length axial row preserves the interface without inventing thickness.
semantics.description: Module-local axial placement or optical reference coordinate. A coordinate is not a measured material thickness.
